sentiment_breakdown.retail_pulse: Extremely bullish enthusiasm across r/wallstreetbets, X/FinTwit, and Threads. Retail traders are celebrating CoreWeave's top-line beat ($3.66B vs $3.54B), operating profit turnaround ($207M vs -$49M in Q2), and the $20B-$21B exit ARR guide. Discussion is dominated by CoreWeave outmaneuvering legacy cloud providers in pure-play AI workload capture.
sentiment_breakdown.sell_side_reaction: Unanimously positive with target price raises anticipated. Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, and Deutsche Bank highlighted the $9B customer prepayment inflow, raised full-year operating income (+26% at midpoint), and contracted power expansion to 4.6 GW as definitive evidence that CoreWeave is widening its lead in AI compute infrastructure.
sentiment_breakdown.management_tone: Aggressive, commanding, and operationally rigorous. Michael Intrator exuded immense confidence regarding power interconnection execution, Blackwell B200 customer allocations, and balance sheet self-funding through customer prepayments.
sentiment_breakdown.options_iv_crush: Options implied move was ±19.95% ($9.57). With the stock gaining +7.90% (+$3.85 to $52.58) after-hours, the move stayed comfortably within the implied straddle band, generating rapid IV crush on weekly options contracts and delivering profits to net options sellers.

after_hours_driver: CRWV shares surged +7.90% to $52.58 in after-hours trading as CoreWeave crushed third-quarter revenue consensus ($3,661M vs $3,540.79M), swung to positive GAAP operating income of $207.0M, raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $13.0B-$13.3B, lifted exit ARR guidance to $20.0B-$21.0B, and announced an anticipated $9.0B influx of customer prepayments and deposits over the next three months.
